corrections.text: The article states the project's download page listed "Latest release date: 2026-09-04" as if that were a single verbatim string on the page. The download page's table actually shows "Latest release date" as a column header and "2026-09-04" as a separate data cell for the 2026.08 row; the two are never concatenated with a colon. The underlying fact — Buildroot 2026.08's release date is 2026-09-04 — is accurate and is directly readable from the table.
